plan_item: 77.44.7.B — preserve backward native Rich Text selection across Inspector rerender
finding: Real Chromium mouse input selected list-item text backwards, but getRichTextFormattingSelection stored only document-ordered ranges. After an inline-format command rerendered the contenteditable surface, restoreRichTextFormattingSelection recreated a forward selection, silently changing the user's anchor/focus direction.
change: Canonical structured selections now retain backward:true when the native anchor is the normalized Range end; forward selection objects remain unchanged.
Restoration now uses Selection.setBaseAndExtent or the Selection.extend fallback to preserve direction after DOM replacement and Inspector formatting.

The Chromium lifecycle now creates native forward and reverse mouse drags across two LI nodes, checks canonical offsets and anchor/focus direction, applies underline/strikethrough, then checks Canvas, Save, separate Publish and public renderer parity at 390px and 1366px.
The Editor module cache-bust token was advanced in index.html and the affected app/richtext module imports. The source-traceability crosswalk was regenerated after app.js changed.
